articles.title: Iran’s ‘silent killing’ plot? US intelligence warns of dirty bomb threat against Trump officials
articles.description: US intelligence has reportedly raised concerns about an alleged Iranian plot targeting senior Trump administration officials using a dirty bomb or chemical weapons. Iran has rejected the chemical weapons allegations, while Washington continues to monitor potential security threats. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's reported relocation to military housing has further intensified concerns.
